items.title: Buffalo Edges Miami 34-31 in OT
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio— The Miami University football team fell to Buffalo 34-31 in overtime Tuesday night at Yager Stadium, snapping the RedHawks' three-game win streak. items.title: Time Change: Nov. 10 Contest Versus Ohio Moved to 8 p.m.
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio – The Mid-American Conference has announced the Nov. 10 football contest versus Ohio has been moved to 8 p.m. and will be carried live on ESPN2. It is the final home contest of the season for the RedHawks.

items.title: RedHawks Put Win Streak on the Line Versus Buffalo on Tuesday
items.summary: The Miami University football team puts its three-game win streak on the line on Tuesday, Nov. 3 versus the Buffalo Bulls in a crucial Mid-American Conference matchup. The contest is scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. and be carried live on ESPN.

items.title: Miami Holds Weekly Press Conference
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio -- Miami University head football coach Chuck Martin, along with redshirt junior Roosevelt Andrews III, spoke with the local media on Monday morning as the RedHawks prepare to face Buffalo on Tuesday, Nov. 3.

items.title: Time Change: Miami to Face Buffalo at 8 p.m. on ESPN
items.summary: CLEVELAND, Ohio – The Mid-American Conference has announced the Miami versus Buffalo football contest will begin at 8 p.m. (originally scheduled for 7 p.m.) and be carried live on ESPN Tuesday, Nov. 3.

items.title: 'Get Back Up and Finish': Miami Battles to 28-27 Win at CMU
items.summary: MOUNT PLEASANT, Mich.— Caleb Heavner wouldn't stay down for long.   And neither would the Miami University football team.   Heavner shrugged off a violent hit in the third quarter to return to the game without missing any time and then helped will the RedHawks to a crucial 28-27 road win at Central Michigan down the stretch Saturday afternoon.

items.title: RedHawks Face CMU on Saturday Afternoon
items.summary: The Miami University football team hits the road to face the Central Michigan Chippewas on Saturday, Oct. 24. Opening kick is slated for 1 p.m. on ESPN+

items.title: Football Holds Weekly Press Conference
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio -- Miami University head football coach Chuck Martin, along with senior offensive lineman Eric Smith, spoke with the local media on Monday morning as the RedHawks prepare to face Central Michigan on Saturday, Oct. 24.

items.title: RedHawk Rewind Episode No. 38: Scoop Smith
items.summary: Scoop Smith joins the podcast to recap Miami Football's dramatic win at UMass, break down his favorite sports memories, talk about the annual Thanksgiving turkey giveaway he organizes, play a true-or-false trivia game about famous Bobs (in honor of Bob the Builder?), and much more.
